newsitem.title: USA: Personnel Group to acquire Vital Computer.
newsitem.headline: Personnel Group to acquire Vital Computer.

text.p: Personnel Group of America Inc, an information technology and staffing services company, said Thursday it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Vital Computer Services International Inc.

Vital Computer, a New York-based company in the same line of business, had revenues of $33.2 million in 1996 and has offices in New York City; Livingston, N.J.; Washington, D.C.; and Miami, Fla., Personnel Group said.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed, but the proposed acquisition is expected to close in early June, it said.
Personnel Group said the acquisition will broaden its geographic coverage to 197 offices in 37 states and the District of Columbia.

After the acquisition is complete, it said it will have nine companies engaged in information technology and 13 companies in commercial staffing. Its health care services division will continue to operate under the Nursefinders brand, it said.
